semantics.sampling: State changes on rising clk; outputs decode registered water level and last-change direction. Between edges inputs do not alter outputs. This follows the specified synchronous state machine.
semantics.reset: Active-high synchronous reset overrides s and establishes below-low state with all four outputs asserted.
semantics.direction: At an intermediate level dfr is 1 if the previous distinct sampled water level was lower, 0 if higher; unchanged levels retain direction. Compare levels even for skipped sensors.
semantics.initialization: No power-up initialization specified; deterministic behavior is required after synchronous reset.

numeric.sensor_encoding: Unsigned 3-bit thermometer code, s[0] lowest, s[2] highest
numeric.arithmetic: Only level ordering comparisons; no rounding or overflow

verification.oracle: Independent integer water-level model derived from original prose and table, persistent last-change direction
verification.directed: Reset phase and priority, every ordered pair of levels, rising/falling history, repeated level hold, skipped levels, input changes between edges
verification.checks: Case-inequality comparison after edge settling and before rising edges, fatal mismatch, bounded timeout, explicit PASS

specification_ambiguities.resolution: Exclude from correctness oracle; RTL holds state for these patterns.
No initial RTL values and no required pre-reset output value.

specification_ambiguities.issue: Clock edge is implicit in synchronous FSM wording
specification_ambiguities.resolution: Use rising clk with no additional latency.
